Maharashtra mandates Marathi test for taxi, auto driver licenses

Maharashtra's transport minister announced that taxi and auto-rickshaw drivers must pass a Marathi language test to retain their licenses. The new rule is set to take effect from August 16. This mandate applies to drivers operating in the state, with failure to pass resulting in license cancellation.
